notes.title: Ashen Arrows is OUT NOW – Unleash Your Inner Viking!
notes.content:
The wait is over! 🏹 Ashen Arrows, the award-winning VR archery adventure, is out now! Step into Nordic mythology, master your bow, and prove your skill in battle.

⚔️ Two Ways to Become a Legend:
🔥 Saga Mode – Face deadly trials, solve ancient puzzles, and carve your name into history in a heroic single-player campaign.
🛡️ Bastion Mode – Rally up to two allies in a roguelike co-op battle for survival. Defend your stronghold against endless waves of foes!

🏆 Winner of the Tencent Games Without Borders Best VR Game Award!

Are you ready to master VRchery and embrace the call of the gods? The legend begins NOW. 
Play today on Steam!

We’d love to hear your thoughts—leave a review on the store and be part of the Ashen Arrows Viking saga! 🏹⚡

- Rusty Pipes Games and VRKiwi

notes.title: Update (getting ready for the full release)
notes.content:
Added Voice chat in co-op mode
Added leaderboard in the Lobby (separately for single and co-op games)
Added new mini game in the Lobby: Cat hunt
Added new skills (and new ways to unlock some "hidden" skills)
Introduced elemental damage types and elemental weaknesses on the enemy side
In the Lobby the skill info panel contains more data, added Bestiary (enemy database) and an announcer selection option
Added new options in the menu: bow offset, player size (to scale your hand and bow - from child to Viking size :smile:)
-Added new languages Spanish, German, French, Korean, Japanese, Hungarian

notes.title: A Goblintastic Hotfix! - Introducing the Lootgoblin
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42679354/51cb954319889d5ba9c8c0a779b7b033036fd7dd.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, brave archers! [/b]

Prepare yourselves for an adventure as a mischievous lootgoblin has arrived into our realm, bearing precious treasures in the form of an exciting update. This small but mighty hotfix is bound to make your arrows fly straighter and your victories shine brighter!

Keep your eyes peeled and your quivers at the ready, for[b] the lootgoblin may appear[/b]. Hunt it down and claim extra skill points, ensuring you become an even more formidable force on the battlefield.  

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[u]Improvements:[/u]
[list]
[*] Be cautious of the potential arrival of Lootgoblin, hunt it down for extra skill points
[*] Added save slot selection. Now, when you share the game with your family and friends, you can easily manage multiple saves.*
[*] Added an option to adjust the bow's offset
[*] Enhanced feedback for weakspot hits
[*] Added feedback for Frigg's Plenty skill
[*] Increased the size of floating texts
[*] Reduced the cooldown on hand gesture interactions
[*] Added an Easter egg in relation to the hot summer - you'll see ;)
[/list]
[u]Bugfixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where some enemies became stuck under the platform on the Riverside map
[*] Fixed discomfort while using the Pine tar skill on the Forge map
[*] Fixed an issue where in co-op games the Hourglass skill was affecting not only the enemies but also the client player
[/list]
[u]Balance:[/u]
[list]
[*] Increased the strength of the basic bow
[*] Decreased the explosion damage of Bug enemies
[*] Strengthened the Dragonsparks skill
[*] Enhanced the Roadside Tavern skill
[/list]
(* For players who already have a saved game, here's an important note: Your previous save is now located in Slot 1, so you won't lose any progress. All your unlocked skills are still there. However, please note that we will only record the time played from this point forward. -If you are not happy about this please write to the devs on Discord and they will update your play time.)

Don't forget, we value your feedback! Help us improve your gaming experience by reporting any bugs or issues you encounter.

notes.title: Hotfix - Coop fixes and improved visuals
notes.content:
This update ensures smoother gameplay and improved skill functionality. We have fine-tuned some skills that were previously inconsistent in cooperative play, enhancing the cooperative experience for you and your friends. Additionally, we have resolved minor visual issues. 

Join forces with your allies and dive into the enhanced cooperative gameplay after this hotfix for Ashen Arrows!

[u]Changelog:[/u]
[list]
[*] fixed a bug where the Ratatoskr Arrow skill didn't have effect when used by a client in a coop game
[*] fixed a bug where the Whistle Arrow skill didn’t have effect when used by a client in a coop game
[*] fixed a bug where Fungus skill didn't trigger in a coop game
[*] fixed a bug where the thunder bomb flew in a strange spin
[*] fixed a visual bug when weapons had continous sparkling effect after dropping them
[*] fixed the grab point and position of the hand held staff
[*] visual fixes and particle optimization on enemy status effects: haste and fire
[*] upgraded visuals: throwable bombs now have decals after exploding
[/list]

Don't forget, we value your feedback! Help us improve your gaming experience by reporting any bugs or issues you encounter.

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS -- June 12th!
notes.content:
[h3]Early Access is coming![/h3]

[b]We are excited to announce that Ashen Arrows will be available for early access starting on June 12th, and we want to share the excitement with our amazing community. As a token of our appreciation, we are giving away free Steam keys![/b]

▶ Join us for a Twitch live event on June 12th starting at 6 PM (EST time), where we will be distributing these keys. To participate, all you have to do is join the Ashen Arrows Discord server before June 12th at 5 PM (EST time). Every member on the server will have the opportunity to be chosen by the gods and receive a key.
(Even if you can't follow the live stream, don't worry! If you are selected as a winner, you will receive your key via direct message after the live stream.)

▶ To increase your chances of winning, we invite you to watch our Twitch live stream on June 12th, starting at 6 PM (EST time). During the stream, we will be giving away a total of 20 keys. Ten keys will be randomly drawn from our Discord members, and the other ten keys will be revealed during the stream itself.
Join us in celebrating the early access release of Ashen Arrows and be a part of this exciting event. Don't miss out on your chance to grab a free Steam key and embark on your epic adventure!

🎯Join [url=https://discord.gg/6bacFtvvY4]Ashen Arrows discord server[/url]
🔥 Watch live stream on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/southpawvirtual]Twitch[/url] on June 12th 6 PM
🏹Wishlist Ashen Arrows to be notified when the game is available!

[i]During the live stream skewed will be our host, who is a devoted fan of Ashen Arrows.
Skewed's channel offers a unique perspective on VR gameplay, and he showcases a diverse range of games across different genres. As a left-handed geek, he brings a fresh and immersive experience to his VR adventures, with a particular emphasis on co-op games..
Follow southpawvirtual on Twitch for VR gameplays including some truly impressive runs of Ashen Arrows![/i]

[h3]What happened since the demo version?[/h3]

Since the release of the demo version, our community has shown us huge support, for which we are incredibly grateful! We have made significant [b]improvements [/b]to the game and here are some notable additions:
[list]
[*] [b]CO-OP Gameplay:[/b] We have introduced a cooperative experience where three archers can join forces to defend against a wide array of enemies in the Bastion game mode.
[*] [b]Expanded Viking Archer Storyline:[/b] The saga of the Viking archer continues across three brand-new maps, offering players a deeper and more engaging narrative.
[*] [b]Enhanced Roguelike Experience:[/b] The popular Bastion game mode, known for its roguelike elements, now features four distinct maps, providing players with even more variety and challenges.
[*] [b]New Skills:[/b] We have introduced a range of exciting new skills that players can acquire and master, expanding the strategic possibilities and adding more depth to the gameplay.
[/list]
We remain dedicated to further improving and expanding the game based on the invaluable feedback and support from our wonderful community.

Ps: We have already started working on the next content update. ːsteamhappyː
